item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 22c69ee1; d7ea6177 replaces _review_row_block with _review_for_promotion so promotion.py:3207 names the head, adds _run_promoted_revision, _reviewed_head and _unreviewed_refusal, and gives partial review records an identity-keyed path at review.py:480; 2bfc54a2 appends the plan landing comment, the evidence section and the figure with zero deletions.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for four behaviours in tests/test_promotion_reads_the_matching_review.py plus a declared negative control and no added neighbour failures; the focused file carries test_promotion_reads_the_review_of_the_revision_it_promotes at :151, test_only_a_review_of_an_earlier_head_refuses_the_promotion at :183, test_a_waiver_still_lands_a_run_whose_review_is_of_an_earlier_head at :208 and the partial-record test at :223, the manifest records the control's 3-failed log, and the three neighbour suites report 25 passed at both base and change.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a promotion read the stored review whose reviewed_head_sha matches the revision it promotes and refuse as unreviewed when only a review of an earlier head exists; at the reviewed head reckon/crew/promotion.py:3207 calls read_review with reviewed_head_sha=promoted_revision, and reckon/crew/promotion.py:3226 _run_promoted_revision resolves that revision from the run's own cited tip so the gate and the promoted row compare one revision rather than two.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at the run directory; it is status complete with an empty blockers line, names base 22c69ee1, commits d7ea6177 and 2bfc54a2, the six carried paths, the gate and base logs, the bare negative-control path, and its follow_ons name recovery.py:_stored_review's unnamed read that the gate compensates for.

justifications.durability: tests/test_promotion_reads_the_matching_review.py:171 asserts the promoted row's review total is 100 while the only other stored record scores 5 per dimension, so reinstating the unnamed read reddens it with 25 == 100 exactly as negative-control.log records, and the expected digits come from the two records the store holds rather than from a value handed to the code under test.
justifications.evidence: the four focused behaviours and the 3-failed negative control are recorded, but gate-after.log:1 pins its 29-pass run to revision 22c69ee1 where tests/test_promotion_reads_the_matching_review.py does not exist, so the one field the gate convention uses to pin a pass names a tree carrying neither the new file nor the run's own assertions.
